title: Distributed kernelware
description: The lab's long-running aim is to engineer a truly distributed operating system — a kernelware — with embedded cells and primitives for foreseen and unforeseen computations on heterogeneous platforms.

title: ExaScale HPC middleware
description: Middleware for fully distributed, scalable, possibly virtualized and dynamically reconfigurable high-performance systems, including enclave management, scheduling and resource discovery.

title: Distributed complex event processing
description: Scaling CEP beyond a single engine so high-rate event streams can be processed across a distributed event-processing network, with middleware for federated CEP systems.

title: Cloud virtualization and VM scheduling
description: Virtualization-aware resource management for clouds and clusters: VM scheduling, virtual clusters, and VMM-level I/O, networking and application-aware control.
